---
title: "Let's Connect"
subtitle: "Questions, ideas, and collaboration"
description: "Contact Elias Mohellebi by email or connect on LinkedIn for course questions, research discussions, and collaborations."
body-classes: contact-page
format:
  html:
    css:
      - /styles-20260924.css
      - contact.css
resources:
  - contact.js
---

```{=html}
<div class="contact-connect">
  <section class="contact-intro" aria-labelledby="contact-intro-title">
    <p class="contact-eyebrow">A conversation starts with a connection</p>
    <h2 id="contact-intro-title">Have a question or an idea?</h2>
    <p>I welcome course questions, research discussions, and opportunities to collaborate. Reach out by email or connect with me on LinkedIn.</p>
  </section>

  <div class="contact-channels">
    <section class="contact-channel contact-channel-email" aria-labelledby="contact-email-title">
      <span class="contact-icon" aria-hidden="true"><i class="bi bi-envelope"></i></span>
      <p class="contact-eyebrow">Direct contact</p>
      <h3 id="contact-email-title">Send me an email</h3>
      <p>For a question, a project idea, or a more detailed conversation.</p>
      <p id="contact-email" class="contact-address" tabindex="-1">ezmo@uark.edu</p>
      <div class="contact-actions">
        <a class="btn btn-primary" href="mailto:ezmo@uark.edu"><i class="bi bi-envelope" aria-hidden="true"></i> Email me</a>
        <button class="btn btn-outline-primary" id="contact-copy-email" type="button" aria-describedby="contact-copy-status" hidden><i class="bi bi-copy" aria-hidden="true"></i> Copy email address</button>
      </div>
      <p class="contact-hint">The email button opens your email application. Using webmail? Copy the address into a new message.</p>
      <p class="contact-copy-status" id="contact-copy-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"></p>
    </section>

    <section class="contact-channel" aria-labelledby="contact-linkedin-title">
      <span class="contact-icon" aria-hidden="true"><i class="bi bi-linkedin"></i></span>
      <p class="contact-eyebrow">Professional connections</p>
      <h3 id="contact-linkedin-title">Connect on LinkedIn</h3>
      <p>Stay connected and exchange ideas about research, teaching, and data analysis.</p>
      <div class="contact-actions">
        <a class="btn btn-outline-primary" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/elias-z-mohellebi" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Visit my LinkedIn profile <i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="visually-hidden"> (opens in a new tab)</span></a>
      </div>
      <p class="contact-hint">Opens LinkedIn in a new tab.</p>
    </section>
  </div>

  <section class="contact-course-note" aria-labelledby="contact-course-note-title">
    <h3 id="contact-course-note-title">Writing about a course?</h3>
    <p>Please include the course name and the chapter, lecture, or assignment related to your question. You can find course materials in the <a href="../teaching/">Teaching section</a>.</p>
  </section>
</div>
<script src="contact.js" defer></script>
```
